RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel is not itself evidence of discrimination. In finance and risk, senior panels are often male simply because the senior population is. Composition becomes meaningful only alongside other facts — and here you have some: a successful candidate with apparently weaker formal qualifications, a vague competency statement ("broad experience of regulatory affairs"), and two weeks of silence on a reasonable request.

So lead with the substance, not the panel. Chase the written reasons in writing, referencing your right to feedback and the selection criteria. Ask how each shortlisted candidate scored against them. Mention panel composition only later, as context, if the reasons you get back look thin or shifting.
